extracted.name: Grilled Swordfish
extracted.description: Grilled swordfish, that’s marinated in teriyaki sauce and basted with butter as it cooks on the grill, is a fish dish the whole family can enjoy.
instruction_lines: Gather all ingredients. Preheat an outdoor grill for medium heat and lightly oil the grate.
Meanwhile, marinate swordfish in teriyaki sauce, 5 minutes per side.
Grill swordfish, basting frequently with melted butter, until fish flakes easily with a fork, 5 to 6 minutes per side.
Season with garlic powder and serve.
